mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tax_detail (tax_type, tax_name, rate, quick_deduction, min_threshold, max_limit, description, effective_year, is_active) VALUES (#{taxType}, #{taxName}, #{rate}, #{quickDeduction}, #{minThreshold}, #{maxLimit}, #{description}, #{effectiveYear}, #{isActive})
mapper.update: UPDATE tax_detail SET tax_type = #{taxType}, tax_name = #{taxName}, rate = #{rate}, quick_deduction = #{quickDeduction}, min_threshold = #{minThreshold}, max_limit = #{maxLimit}, description = #{description}, effective_year = #{effectiveYear}, is_active = #{isActive} WHERE id = #{id}
